ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 12:1 ratio of low-intensity dark pixels to high-intensity white/light-gray pixel clusters across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark gray/black base pigmentation with high-frequency, high-contrast white speckling (scattered clusters) across both lobes; notable high-intensity vertical linear grouping on the inner right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a pixel-measured internal angle of approximately 94 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations with a frequency of approximately 3-5 peaks per 100 pixels along the trailing edge boundary; amplitude of serrations increases at distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve transitioning from the central notch to broadly rounded distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (3-10 pixel diameter) distributed across the central and left lobe surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, high-contrast parallel linear marks (rake-like features) oriented vertically on the inner right fluke lobe; one minor diagonal linear disruption on the far left distal margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel rake-mark scarring located on the right inner lobe near the median notch.
